description: This file defines public API functions for interacting with backend endpoints related to work items, including CRUD operations like get, create, delete, update, and patch. It also imports configuration and builds URLs.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or null, throwing on non-2xx responses.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error if the request fails.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, properly encoding URL parameters.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON PATCH request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items from the backend, with optional filtering by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, such as a task or bug, with provided details.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified work item via PATCH request.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL string for a given API path.

ctags.name: createWorkItem
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })

ctags.name: updateWorkItemStatus
ctags.pattern: /^export async function updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status }) {$/
